title: OM Bank - Data Analyst
text:
Let's Write Africa's Story Together!
Old Mutual is a firm believer in the African opportunity and our diverse talent reflects this.
Job Description
At OM Bank, we strive to attract great people who are passionate about coming together for a higher purpose, building something unique and aspirational, and always aiming to be the best they can be. We are rooted in our purpose of inspiring and enabling our customers to grow and sustain their prosperity.
This role is responsible for supporting data driven decision making across the business by analysing, interpreting, and reporting on data from various sources. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to understand information needs, produce meaningful insights, and develop reporting solutions that help improve customer outcomes, business performance, and operational efficiency.
The Data Analyst will be responsible for collecting, preparing, and validating data, creating reports and dashboards, monitoring key performance indicators, and identifying trends and opportunities within the data. The role requires strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non technical audiences.
The successful candidate will contribute to building a culture of evidence based decision making by transforming data into actionable insights that support business objectives and strategic priorities. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop analytical, reporting, and stakeholder engagement skills within a fast growing and innovative banking environment.
KEY RESULT AREAS
Data Analysis and Insights
• Analyse data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
• Perform exploratory analysis to answer business questions and support decision making.
• Translate data findings into clear and actionable business insights.
Reporting and Visualisation
• Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and scorecards.
• Ensure reporting outputs are accurate, relevant, and aligned with business requirements.
• Present findings in a clear and easy to understand manner for both technical and non technical audiences.
Data Collection and Preparation
• Collect, clean, validate, and prepare data for analysis and reporting purposes.
• Assist in maintaining data quality by identifying inconsistencies, gaps, and anomalies.
• Work with data owners to resolve data quality issues where required.
Business Requirements Support
• Engage with stakeholders to understand reporting and analytical requirements.
• Translate business needs into reporting specifications and analytical outputs.
• Support the development of measurement frameworks and key performance indicators.
Performance Improvement through Analytics
• Support business teams by identifying opportunities for operational and customer experience improvements through data analysis.
• Monitor business performance metrics and highlight significant changes or emerging trends.
• Contribute to evidence based recommendations that support business objectives.
Data Governance and Controls
• Follow data governance, privacy, and security standards when handling data.
• Ensure data used for reporting and analysis meets defined quality and compliance requirements.
• Maintain clear documentation of reports, data sources, and business definitions.
Stakeholder Engagement
• Build positive working relationships with internal stakeholders.
• Respond to reporting requests and provide analytical support to business users.
• Assist in communicating analytical findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
Personal Capability Building
• Develop knowledge of analytical tools, reporting platforms, and banking products.
• Stay informed about emerging trends and best practices in data analytics and business intelligence.
• Participate in training and continuous learning opportunities to build analytical capability.
ROLE REQUIREMENTS
• Relevant qualification in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Preferably Bachelors Degree.
• 1 to 2 years experience in a Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, or similar analytical role.
• Experience working with Power BI.
• Experience using SQL for data extraction and analysis.
• Exposure to Python, R, or other analytical tools would be advantageous.
• Experience within the banking or financial services industry would be advantageous.

title: Agentic AI Engineer
text:
Meet Ozow
Ozow is a leading fintech company that's redefining digital payments in South Africa and beyond. We're dedicated to making payments more accessible, secure, and convenient for both businesses and consumers. As a fast-growing player in the financial technology sector, Ozow fosters a culture of innovation, diversity, and inclusivity. We believe in pushing the boundaries of what's possible and are committed to making a positive impact on the world through our payment solutions.
More about this Ozow fantastic position
Join the team building AI agents that automate real work across Ozow, from operations and support to fraud, risk and engineering workflows. You'll build, test and ship agent components alongside senior engineers, and learn how to put AI safely into production in a regulated payments environment.
Your role and responsibilities
Agent delivery
• Ship at least one agent feature to production within your first 6 months, with evaluation tests in place.
• Work with product, operations and risk teams to understand the process an agent will support.
• Bring forward ideas for new automation use cases, backed by the problem they solve.
Build and integrate
• Build and maintain agent workflows: tool calling, retrieval (RAG), prompt design and multi-step task orchestration.
• Connect agents to internal APIs and data sources through secure, well-scoped integrations.
• Write clean, tested code that passes review against team standards.
Quality, reliability and safety
• Write evaluation tests that check agent outputs for accuracy, reliability and safety before release.
• Monitor agents in production, triage failures and feed findings back into improvements.
• Explain the failure modes of what you've built and how they're caught.
• Handle personal and financial data in line with POPIA and Ozow policy.
Tool Utilisation + Change Management
• Document how each agent works, what it can and cannot do, and where a human signs off.
• Follow Ozow's change, release and security processes for every AI feature.
• Help business users adopt new agent tools through clear guides and demos.
Automation and AI
• Use AI coding assistants responsibly to speed up your own delivery.
• Keep up with agent frameworks, MCP (Model Context Protocol) and model releases, and share what's useful with the team.
• Flag manual processes that are good candidates for automation.
You are an ideal candidate if you have
• A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Solid Python, and comfort working with REST APIs and JSON.
• Hands-on experience building with at least one LLM API, shown through a project, GitHub repo or production work.
• Basic understanding of RAG, embeddings and prompt engineering.
• Git, and working knowledge of Docker.
• A careful approach to data: you understand why personal and financial data needs protecting.
Nice to have
• Exposure to an agent framework (for example LangGraph, CrewAI or an agent SDK) or to MCP.
• AWS experience.
• C# or .NET, since much of our platform runs on ASP.NET Core.
• SQL (SQL Server or PostgreSQL).
• Interest in payments, fraud or financial services.

• Ability to initiate, develop, maintain and leverage outstanding relationships to influence a wide network, both inside and outside the company.
• A trailblazer who steps up, takes charge, and creates meaningful impact—those driven by performance and purpose to lead from the front and make a real difference every day.
• You thrive in collaboration, embrace inclusion, and bring a genuine curiosity for global cultures—valuing collective success over individual credit.
• Demonstrate strategic foresight, sound judgement, and the ability to make confident decisions under uncertainty, always working toward the best possible outcomes.
• You challenge norms, champion innovation, and constantly seek growth—for themselves, their team, and the solutions they build.
• You are a decisive doer—those who take initiative, follow through with confidence, and ensure results through courageous, hands-on leadership.
• We value optimism, agility, and the strength to persevere under pressure—balancing performance with positivity, even in challenging environments.
• You are driven, proactive individuals who take ownership, face challenges with grit, and consistently push for excellence—not just as participants, but as catalysts for success.
Interview process
During the interview process you will meet with the People team, the hiring manager, and relevant CSuite. Our process may include psychometric and technical assessments, giving you an opportunity to demonstrate your strengths, skills and potential beyond your CV and interview.

At Ozow, we don't just process payments. We are redefining the future of how money moves. Our promise to our people is simple. Ozow is built for high impact: clear expectations, genuine investment in you, and the room to do work you are proud of. We back you to own what you deliver and how you grow, and we recognise the people who lift others, not just themselves. People are trusted to make decisions and own outcomes, where the growth you create, in yourself and in others, is part of how we succeed together.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
text:
OfferZen's client, Wonderful.ai is hiring for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join their growing team!
Wonderful.ai is a young start-up with $300M raised, and is now valued at $2B after 18 months of operations. They've grown to 600 employees across 32 countries, with an engineering team that includes people from Google, Palantir, Databricks, Microsoft, and Slack. They enable enterprises to build, test, deploy, and monitor AI agents for their most complex needs, serving customers and employees seamlessly across voice, chat, email, and back-office systems in any language or cultural context.
Role Overview
As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Wonderful, you’ll solve high-impact, real-world problems alongside enterprise customers and own work from first principles through production outcomes.
You’ll work directly with customers to understand critical workflows, design AI-driven solutions, and deploy agents that operate reliably in production. You’ll own projects end-to-end from problem definition and system design to launch and iteration - and be accountable for real business impact.
This is a hands on-generalist role for engineers who enjoy navigating ambiguity, learning quickly, and working across systems while partnering with enterprises as they become AI-driven organizations.
What You’ll Do
• Partner with customers to understand operational challenges and success criteria
• Translate open-ended problems into clear technical designs and implementations
• Build AI agents that integrate with customer systems and perform real tasks
• Own deployments, including reliability, performance, and continuous improvement
• Test with real data, measure outcomes, and iterate based on results
• Collaborate with Product & Engineering to ship high-quality solutions
• Contribute to tools, documentation, and best practices that scale customer delivery
What We’re Looking For
• 5+ years of experience in software engineering or technical problem-solving roles
• Strong fundamentals in software design, system thinking
• Experience working across systems, integrations, and data flows
• Comfort working directly with customers and owning ambiguous problems
• Clear communication skills and a strong ownership mindset
• Curiosity and interest in building AI-powered systems that work in practice
Nice to Have
• Experience in forward-deployed, solutions engineering, or customer-facing roles
• Exposure to AI agents, automation, or conversational systems
• Experience operating and improving production systems
Logistics
• Location: must be based in or willing to relocate to Johannesburg (office is in Rosebank)
• Office attendance: ~4 days a week on-site, typically at a client's office, not Wonderful's own office
• Citizenship/visa: no strict requirement to be SA citizen, but no visa sponsorship available — candidate must already have the right to work in SA
• Compensation expectation: targeting 95th–99th percentile of local market rates - they’re willing to pay top of the range for talent, skill and experience
• Pay structure: paid in ZAR, but employee can choose to anchor salary value to USD (converted at spot rate monthly) if they wish

title: Senior Manager - Payment Partnerships
text:
About us:
Luno is the crypto investment app you can rely on, enabling you to buy, store and explore crypto securely. We’re committed to putting the power of cryptocurrency in everyone's hands, sensibly and responsibly. Since 2013, we’ve helped millions of people around the world invest safely in crypto. We do this by cutting through the hype and supporting customers at every step of the way. All products and cryptocurrencies on our platform must first meet stringent legal, risk and technical security standards.Transparency is key for us. Luno stores all crypto on a 1:1 basis and we have rigorous processes in place so you can be confident your investment is secure. We're available in multiple markets around the world and we work closely with regulators and other key stakeholders to ensure compliance with local laws, as we believe this is the best way to help everyone, everywhere, invest safely.
The role in a nutshell:
We’re looking for a commercially sharp Senior Manager, Payment Partnerships to join GTXN - a Luno company and own the sourcing, negotiation and delivery of new banking and payment-provider partnerships across Africa and Southeast Asia. You will be responsible for identifying, engaging and closing arrangements with the payment providers and banks that let GTXN move money for our customers reliably, quickly and at the right cost. This is a remote-first role, and you will report to Paul Harker.
You will bring hands-on experience building payment-provider and banking relationships in African markets, and be comfortable owning a deal from first conversation through contracting and go-live. Experience doing the same in Southeast Asia is a strong advantage.
Your mission will be:
• Identify, prioritise and build a pipeline of payment providers, banks and PSPs across African markets (and select Southeast Asian markets) that can extend GTXN’s ability to move money for Luno’s customers.
• Own end-to-end deal execution: outreach, commercial negotiation, contracting and onboarding of new banking and payment-provider partners.
• Manage and grow a portfolio of existing partner relationships, acting as the primary point of contact for commercial, operational and performance matters.
• Negotiate commercial terms — pricing, settlement, liability, SLAs — that improve the cost, coverage and reliability of GTXN’s payment rails.
• Work closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk and Product/Engineering to ensure new partnerships meet regulatory, licensing and integration requirements before go-live.
• Monitor partner performance against agreed SLAs (uptime, settlement times, success rates) and drive remediation where partners underperform.
• Track regulatory, competitive and market developments across target emerging markets that could affect partner selection or deal terms.
• Represent GTXN with key partners and at industry events, building GTXN’s reputation as a partner of choice in target markets.
• Feed market intelligence into GTXN’s regional expansion strategy, helping prioritise markets and partners with the strongest commercial and strategic fit.
A little about you:
• 5-8+ years of experience in payment partnerships, business development or commercial roles at a payment service provider, bank, remittance company or fintech, with a track record of sourcing and closing deals with banks and payment providers.
• Demonstrable experience engaging with payment providers and banks across African markets; experience doing the same in Southeast Asia is a strong advantage.
• Deep understanding of cross-border payment flows and the commercial and technical mechanics of PSP and banking partnerships (settlement, FX, licensing, compliance).
• Proven ability to independently source, negotiate and close commercial agreements, from first contact through contract execution and onboarding.
• Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills, able to structure deals that balance cost, risk and speed to market.
• Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a remote-first, distributed team, across multiple time zones and jurisdictions.
• Excellent relationship-management and stakeholder-management skills, able to work cross-functionally with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Product and Engineering.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages relevant to target African (or Southeast Asian) markets are advantageous.
• An existing network of relationships with payment providers and banks in target African markets is a strong advantage.
• Willingness to travel as required to meet partners and represent GTXN in-market.
• Working knowledge of, and genuine interest in, crypto and digital assets is advantageous, given GTXN's role within the broader Luno business.

• Build a prioritised pipeline of target payment-provider and banking partners across GTXN’s core African markets.
• Develop a strong working knowledge of GTXN’s existing partner network, product and commercial model.
• Close and onboard the first new partner agreement(s) in a priority market.
• Establish effective working relationships with Compliance, Legal, Risk and Product/Engineering to streamline partner onboarding.
• Build credibility as a trusted point of contact for both new and existing partners.
